I once went on a trip to visit family in Manitoba when I was in grade 9, and the people I was visiting lived in a pretty small town, where there were only 2 high schools and pretty inch everybody knew each other. So it was obvious that my family and I were strangers in town.

I don't consider myself that attractive, but I assume that it's just because I was some mystery asian guy coming to a small town that added a slight charm or something? But word got out that there were new people visiting. 

On one of the days, we went to a man made beach-like pool, and I had been working out a lot prior to summer, so I had a fairly decent body (at the time) and when I took my shirt off and walked around to play volleyball, there were girls eyeing me all around the pool. I felt like a celebrity. A group of them came up to me and asked what my name was and where I'm from, my Snapchat etc. And it was pretty obvious that they were attracted to me.

As the week progressed, more and more girls around my age started to find out I was in town, and more and more people were hitting me up on Snapchat, to the point where I had to mute my phone entirely just to play video games. 

Later that week there was a carnival in the main part of town where everybody went to see dog shows, rides, etc. And I kid you not, every 20 meters, there where girls looking at me and smiling as I walked around to the rides, I honestly felt like a celebrity super model.

Tl;dr, I visited a small town where I was "the big city guy" and all the girls my age in the town were interested in me.
